content.name: p
children: The HalaPOS dashboard shows your daily, monthly, and yearly sales, purchases, expenses, and payments.

content.name: p
children: The app top bar displays the first character of your company name as a logo, an icon menu to open the point of sale screen, an add-new dropdown, and — on the right — menus for alerts, reports, settings, and user.

content.name: p
children: HalaPOS has a left side bar that is fully displayed on large screens and collapsed on small screens.

content.name: p
children: The dashboard main area shows the month's and year's sales, purchases, expenses, and payments totals, along with daily sales, purchases, expenses, and payments presented as a heatmap chart for the selected year.
